diagnostic_regions.full_image: all pixels, includes original FOV-excluded labels
diagnostic_regions.bright_band: 15x15 square dilation(bright_core) minus bright_core, inside original FOV; all image locations, not a selected crop
diagnostic_regions.thin_label_proxy: AH AND 5x5 AH sum<=10 AND 3x3 AH sum<=6 AND FOV; diagnostic only, not a clinical vessel-width label
diagnostic_regions.fov_edge: FOV minus constant-zero 15x15 erosion(FOV); evaluation only

comparison_gates.empty_region_policy: report null recall if no GT positives; no claim of protection from an empty set
comparison_gates.ranking_after_all_gates: descending 512 AH macro Dice, then fewer distance filters, shorter length, lower margin, lower penalty, candidate ID
comparison_gates.no_eligible_candidate: REJECT_R2_FAMILY_FOR_PL; preserve all runs, do not relax gates; next revision requires its own preregistration

gate_scope: Apply unchanged Q1 numeric protection/gain gates separately to training AH, heldout AH, training VK, heldout VK; no pooled-all substitute for heldout. Report failures, no post-hoc retuning. Passing quality gates is not clinical acceptance.
order: sorted image_id, then 256/512, then A/C2; 80 unique real PL frames; optional browser preview tasks excluded from fixed cohort
retuning: Forbidden on Q3 heldout/VK. Preserve frozen A28 and C2. Report losses and failures without deleting cases.
timing: Collect core (includes stream stalls), DMA transaction and complete inference per frame. Batch throughput is not browser FPS. Manual browser observations separate. Pure DMA and formal repeated performance remain pending.
remaining: W4 full CPU comparison, independent pure DMA, 3 warm+100 measured x3 configurations x3 repeats, resource/power, W5 >=30min and >=1000 frames, final report and video.
